payload.text: Welcome to the Hawker Heroes launch-readiness meeting.

payload.question: Where exactly in level 5 do players quit?

facts.text: According to the playtest sheet, 12 out of 14 players quit at the start of the second rush.

payload.text: Level 5 difficulty is at 10 minutes, please wrap up.

payload.question: When does Starfruit need the final build?

facts.text: Starfruit needs the final build by 18 November, one week before launch.

payload.text: You haven't spoken in a while. Would you like to add anything?
That covers all 4 agenda items. We have 3 action items assigned. See you next week.

tasks.title: Fix the crash after serving ten customers
tasks.context: Hawker Heroes crashes after serving 10 customers in a row. Raised in the Build and bugs discussion; it blocks the launch build.

tasks.title: Ask a streamer to play Hawker Heroes on launch day
tasks.context: The launch marketing plan has no live stream yet. Find a streamer and propose a launch-day slot.

tasks.title: Post launch date to team channel
tasks.context: Post the confirmed launch date to the team channel so everyone works to the same date.
